_comment: OWL Cron Jobs — Scheduled monitoring and maintenance tasks

jobs.name: monitor-handoffs-incoming
jobs.description: Scan the incoming handoff directory every 5 minutes for new tasks from agents

jobs.name: monitor-handoffs-outgoing
jobs.description: Check outgoing handoffs for stalled tasks that agents haven't picked up

jobs.name: monitor-handoffs-failed
jobs.description: Check failed handoff directory and retry or reassign failed tasks

jobs.name: cleanup-completed
jobs.description: Archive completed handoffs older than 24 hours

jobs.name: healthcheck-gateway
jobs.description: Verify the gateway HTTP endpoint is responsive
